correctness.rationale: For finite metric star r_i>0 and real zero-total-mass σ, centering f and fixing Lip L reduces linear functional to independent positive/negative signed caps a,b. Oscillation bound gives upper 2(P(b)+N(a))/(2+a+b); saturated truncated signed leaf potentials centered at range midpoint attain same value. Legendre/Dinkelbach-type ratio optimality yields unique gamma>0 solving ∫(T_+-gamma)_+ +∫(T_--gamma)_+=2gamma, with norm 2gamma. Each tail is nonincreasing piecewise constant; sort its <=n height intervals and test gamma_k=B_k/(2+A_k) in [h_{k+1},h_k] for O(nlogn) exact arithmetic. Strictly decreasing root and zero-mass special case handled; one vs two-sided minimal optimal caps determined by T_±(0)>gamma. Independently compared exact Fraction root to fresh primal BL LP on 132 heterogeneous, tied, zero and one-sign examples; LP finite corroboration only.

Hille–Theewis general finite-support LP for the sum-normalized Dudley norm is also known, and Sato et al solve another fixed-penalty tree transport.
